quest.title: Scenes from Life in Meropide: The Art of Negotiation
quest.description: You find a strange notice in a book...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Credit Coupons x280

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The "Art of Negotiation"...? Hmph! Even the title is boring! Paimon's not interested in that... Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? There's a note here? Hmm... "Go to the registration counter at the front desk to participate in the Coupon Cafeteria's internal satisfaction survey for a chance to win Coupon rewards..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Coupons... Whoa! See this? We can get Coupons! Paimon didn't expect something this good at all! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Paimon is ready now! Do your worst!)

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Question one. Do you think it is reasonable to maintain the prices for the food in the Coupon Cafeteria at the current low level?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Hmm... How do we answer this? Let Paimon look it up... Found it! Let's try the universal formula.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (According to the book "I agree with your views, but..." can be used in any situation. Even an Abyss Mage would be willing to respond positively. It sounds really amazing.)

choices.text: Reasonable. Paimon quite likes it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah...? Paimon wouldn't touch that horrible stuff even if it was free!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But what if our food budget runs out...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... When you put it like that... N—NO! Paimon would rather starve!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: *Cough* Excuse me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: According to the rules, the survey must be answered quickly. Let's move on to the next question.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: F—Fine... Rules are rules...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Question number two. Is adequate food available during dining hours in the Coupon Cafeteria?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's plenty of food... But it just tastes awful!

choices.text: Yeah, it has more Mint than grows on all of Teyvat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon would rather just eat Mint directly...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Really? Then you can have a Mint Salad today.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No! Paimon doesn't want either of those! *sobs* Paimon wants Sweet Madame...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Anyway... Can we get back to the survey? I'll just put it down as a yes.

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Ugh... This is so tiring. Let's move on to the next question.

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Before we move on to the third question, I'd like to remind you that this survey requires you to answer quickly. So...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Now for the third question. Do you think the current randomized meal system is interesting?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Pay more attention to the taste!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: I agree with your views, but... Doesn't randomized meals create the feeling of a pleasant surprise, of not knowing what you'll get next?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true... When you put it like that, it does sound really interesting!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Miss Monglane made a lot of sense. It's very difficult to disagree!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Ahem, please answer quickly.

choices.text: It's interesting, including the fortune slips.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Every meal comes with a fortune, and it's like drawing lots, it's really nice!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Hard work begets success!" Paimon thinks it's awesome!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It is hard work to guide others.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe.

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Question number four. Do you think it's reasonable to sell addictive foods in the Coupon Cafeteria?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Huh? What? Why is she suddenly speaking faster?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Gain the initiative? Steer the conversation? No! No! None of these seem correct. Maybe... We should go back to the universal formula...)

choices.text: (That's not quite right... These questions...)

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Ahem, please do not overthink it or engage in idle chatter. As I mentioned previously, please answer quickly and intuitively.

choices.text: It's very reasonable...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Alright, thank you for your feedback. Now, it's time for the final question.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did she just completely ignore us? Are our answers not important at all!?

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Based on the answers you've just provided, are you satisfied with the current state of the Coupon Cafeteria?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What were they again? Paimon can't remember all of them!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: It's alright, then I'll just write down that you're satisfied.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay... But something doesn't feel quite right...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: I should probably mention that you will not receive any Coupons if you answer "no."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's way over the line!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: #Then what about you, {M#sir}{F#madam}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't ignore Paimon!

choices.text: Yes, I'm very satisfied.

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Very well. Thank you for your cooperation. Your support is our motivation to improve. Please sign here to claim your Coupons. The intelligent flying clockwork device by your side can sign for the Coupons too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Paimon gets some too!? But Paimon didn't even participate! Is that really okay? Wait! Paimon is Paimon! Not some intelligent flying clockwork device!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Very well. Anyway, we respect all input, so everybody... er, all people and meka are eligible.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't you hear Paimon!? Paimon isn't a flying clockwork device! Paimon is Paimon! Don't ignore Paimon!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Understood... Anyway, in order to help save your precious time, I can fill in the survey for you. Don't worry, the number of Coupons you'll receive won't change.

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: I'm sure you'll be answering "satisfactory" to every question, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes! Coupons!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: In that case, just sign here and leave the rest to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool! This way we'll get the Coupons and save the trouble. Thanks, Ms. Monglane!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: Thank you for your support. Please take your Coupons and we hope you'll participate in the next survey.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After getting the Coupons, you and Paimon bid farewell to Ms. Monglane.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In retrospect, Ms. Monglane didn't really care at all about our responses...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The problem is with the questions themselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're right. The questionnaire really was weird, and Ms. Monglane seemed so exhausted...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Art of Negotiation failed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Art of Negotiation, pshaw! Books like that are all completely useless after all!

choices.text: You're right, the book is the problem.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, totally! So you also think the problem is with the book, right? But since we got some Coupons, Paimon will let it slide.

choices.text: Nope, the problem is with Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But Paimon followed all the books instructions exactly! See, "Loud and proud..." It's all the book's fault after all!

choices.text: I agree with your views, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't you go mocking Paimon now! Hmph, some "Art of Negotiation"... It really was totally useless after all!

choices.text: No, I'm not satisfied at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, wait! No! Write down that we're satisfied! Even if just for the Coupons...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: You're satisfied, huh? Understood.

choices.text: I'm generally satisfied, but...
It's not reasonable, because...
I agree with your views, but...
(Is this... Steering the conversation?)
Not interesting, because I can't eat what I want to.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It always tastes weird. The surprise isn't pleasant at all!

choices.text: I agree with your views, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It would be great if you got a complimentary delicious meal every eighteen meals!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why eighteen?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon heard that from someone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It was something like... Uh... Because there's three meals each day, and there are six days before Sunday, that makes eighteen meals in six days...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So there will be delicious food on the seventh day! And you'll be in a good mood every week!

choices.text: Not enough! Even Wolsey doesn't get to eat any!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He just doesn't want to eat it!

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: I see, so that means there isn't enough...

choices.text: I agree with your views, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we refuse to eat it.

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: *sigh*... I know you've read the book... Anyway, I'll just put it down as a yes...

choices.text: Unreasonable, I want the prices to be raised!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? Why!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Forget the best, we want the most expensive!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of crazy talk is that!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Are you alright...? You don't seem normal at all. Did you eat something strange?

choices.text: I agree with your views, but...

response.speaker: Monglane
response.text: But?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #But there is room for improvement! If only it tasted just a little better! Don't you think so too, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Or... If Sweet Madame was available. Yeah! Paimon would happily eat here every day if you did that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The registration counter at the front desk... This is it! Let's try our luck!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello, Ms. Monglane!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Whoa! She doesn't look like she's easy to get along with!)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Maybe the Art of Negotiation will work?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (That's right, we've got this book! Who knew it would come in handy here?)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see... Found it! "If you gain the initiative by showing your strength and overwhelm your opponent with an imposing manner..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is it! Overwhelm the opponent by being imposing! Paimon gets it! Paimon just has to be louder, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Ms. Monglane! Hello—

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: ...I heard you. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It really worked!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe, we're here for the satisfaction survey, Ms. Monglane! Er, Paimon means to say that she's here to accompany {M#him}{F#her}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #(Don't worry, {NICKNAME}. We have this book. Paimon will sneak peeks at the book and tell you what to do! Anyway... Yeah! Just listen to Paimon!)

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Another one saw the notes in the books...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Yeah, that's right!

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Just how many were...? Actually... Ugh, forget it. It's fine...

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Ahem, please wait a moment... Allow me to explain the rules. The survey has a total of five questions. Please answer them quickly and intuitively. Remember, you must answer them quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Do you understand? We can begin once you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Whoa! Wait! Paimon is still flipping through the book...)

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Very good. Let's hurry up and begin then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please give me a moment to get ready.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: ...Oh. I see. Please be quick about it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (Hey... Why is she being so impatient...?)

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: Are you ready now?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please give me a moment to get ready.

dialogues.speaker: Monglane
dialogues.text: *sigh* Please hurry up then.
